description: This file defines context managers for controlling autograd behavior in PyTorch, such as disabling/enabling gradients, inference mode, multithreading, and view replay in autograd.

classes.name: no_grad
classes.description: Context manager that disables gradient calculation in PyTorch.

classes.name: enable_grad
classes.description: Context manager that enables gradient calculation in PyTorch.

classes.name: set_grad_enabled
classes.description: Context manager and callable to set gradient calculation mode.

classes.name: inference_mode
classes.description: Context manager that enables or disables inference mode, disabling autograd and view tracking.

classes.name: set_multithreading_enabled
classes.description: Context manager to enable or disable multithreaded backward execution.

classes.name: _force_original_view_tracking
classes.description: Context manager to control view-replay in autograd.

classes.name: _unsafe_preserve_version_counter
classes.description: Context manager to preserve tensor version counters, potentially unsafe.

methods.name: _enter_inference_mode
methods.description: Helper function to enter inference mode context.

methods.name: _exit_inference_mode
methods.description: Helper function to exit inference mode context.
